evo_base_note: The EVO-A1 base fragment: byte-for-byte the official-protocol cell (configs/baseline/a2t-direct-official-protocol.json) with its task_instruction_fill REMOVED. rails.evolution.write_candidate_fragments owns task_instruction_fill and task_instruction_fill_params and refuses a base that already sets either -- silently replacing a caller's fill would hide which arm actually flew. This fragment is also the incumbent A_0 arm's own baseline: with no fill declared, core.instructions.resolve_task_instruction falls through to the released compact registry, which is exactly what A_0 is.

system_prompt_variant_note: configs/example_config.yaml at the same commit carries the same four sentences as a YAML block scalar, i.e. separated by newlines and with a trailing newline (sha256 aa2e344ee52c59019b938926f37498e0dc9c80bd01f6521eba5c3d81309a491d) instead of the in-code default's single spaces (sha256 1c52cd2ebca6e4737b706ccc231b01f008d35276a2153000d74ec9500018258a). The two differ ONLY in whitespace (identical under str.split()). This cell flies the in-code default; the YAML variant is recorded as the alternative in the preregistration and is not flown.
